summary: Sentences are correct and natural, but the format is broken in places: flashcards show the same text on both sides, three cloze items have no blank, and two dialogue_turn items have no situation. Spoken and typed answers use full forms ('I am', 'do not') without accepting the contractions natives actually use, and four items have only a generic hint.
